Maamulka Ahlu-sunna Waljameeca ee Gal-gaduud ayaa beeniyay in xilligaan uu dhamaaday waqtigii uu shaqeyn lahaa gudiga Talada ee Maamulkaasi ka dib markii dhawaan Gudoomiyaha gudigaasi Sheekh Cumar Sheekh C/qaadir uu sheegay in waqtigii uu ka dhamaaday.
Gudoomiye ku xigeenka kowaad ee Gudiga Talada Cabdulaahi Cabdi Maxamed oo saxaafadda la hadlay ayaa sheegay in warkaasi uu yahay mid uu ku deg degay gudoomiyaha islamarkaana weli ay heestaan waqti dheeraa
